title: From Reconstruction to Decision: A Post-encoder Plug-in Adapter for Curvilinear Segmentation (PEPA)
mechanism: Post-encoder adapter: target-conditioned snake upsampling to recover thin tortuous structures, plus target-adaptive differentiable thresholding with guards against trivial bias shift; about 0.26M extra params.
adaptation: Attach TCSU to the PF decoder or to a frozen foundation encoder; TADT is a learned form of our val-chosen crack logit bias, so test TCSU first with the known bias fixed.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + TCSU, val bias kept; baseline: PF + val bias; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU. Kill if gain < +0.01.
evidence: R: consistent gains on five medical and industrial benchmarks with frozen-encoder baselines; clDice gains larger than IoU gains (numbers not in abstract).
prior_overlap: Partial: val-chosen crack logit bias tested (+0.004 to +0.007 IoU); snake upsampling untested.

alt_notes.adaptation: Attach the snake upsampling to the PF decoder for the crack channel; skip the thresholding half since our val-chosen crack logit bias already does that.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + snake upsampling; baseline PF + val bias; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU. Kill if < +0.01.

alt_notes.adaptation: Attach to the crack channel of the winning FM arm (or the house decoder); the learned threshold replaces our hand-chosen val crack logit bias.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Winning FM arm + PEPA vs same arm with val-chosen bias; crack IoU and relF1@2 on CV; kill if gain < 0.005 crack IoU.

alt_notes.adaptation: Attach to the FM decoder of the best arm, crack class only; the threshold part overlaps our val-chosen logit bias, so the test is the snake upsampler.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Best FM arm +/- PEPA upsampler, 3 seeds; crack IoU and recall on components < 20 px; kill if < +0.012 crack IoU.

alt_notes.adaptation: Attach to crack and gridline heads of the house decoder or a frozen DINOv3 pipeline; TADT replaces the fixed val-chosen crack logit bias with a per-image threshold (may help source-dependent label width).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house PF + PEPA on crack/gridline; baseline: house PF with val-chosen bias; CV crack IoU, relF1@2, gridline IoU. Kill if crack IoU and relF1@2 n.d.

alt_notes.adaptation: Attach to the house decoder (or a frozen DINOv3 pipeline) on crack and gridline only; adaptive threshold replaces the fixed val-chosen crack bias with a per-image threshold, relevant to the contrast spread across the 5 sources.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm house PF + PEPA vs house PF; 5-fold CV crack relF1@2, crack IoU, gridline IoU; kill: relF1@2 n.d. and gridline < +0.02. About 10 GPU-h.
